Indian wrestlers secure medals at Budapest Ranking Series

Indian wrestlers Neha and Mansi have won medals at the Budapest Ranking Series wrestling competition. Neha secured a gold medal in the 59kg category, while Mansi won a silver medal. These victories contribute to India's overall medal tally, which has now reached eight at the event.
